# Description
This modpack is designed for vanilla gameplay, vanilla-friendly servers, or casual sessions with friends. It aims to stay as close to the original Minecraft experience as possible, enhancing the overall feel without altering the core mechanics or the essence of the game. The pack improves visuals, adds subtle quality-of-life features, and includes enhanced in-game descriptions — all while remaining as true to vanilla Minecraft as possible.
## Core Mods
- Sodium
- iris shaders
- bobby
- simple voise chat
- emote craft
- visuality
- roughly enough items
- zoomify
- better than mending
- lithosphere (world gen mod)
- clicktrough
- inventory managment
- litematica
- trade cycling
and more

The modpack includes a few texture packs and shaders that enhance the visual appearance of the game (you can disable them or add your own if you prefer). It also features various client-side mods that improve visuals, animations, and interface polish.
### Mods aims to enhance the visual
- chat animation
- better F3
- immersive UI
- explosive enhancment
- enchantment description
- presence footsteps
- not enough animations
- small view model (initially disabled, can be enabled in mod settings)
- tiny items animations
- wakes
- visuality
- polytone
